name: Bad Things
overview: Scripture acknowledges that believers will face tribulation and bad things in this world, yet it assures us of Christ's victory over these trials and the peace found in Him. While bad things happen even to good people, God works all things together for good to those who love Him and are called according to His purpose. This hope is grounded in God's love demonstrated through the gift of His Son, promising eternal life to believers. Conversely, the Bible also warns of judgment for the unrepentant, emphasizing the seriousness of unbelief and sin.
